preModelEnvironmentFailure.whyNotTheModelOrTheCandidate: Nothing ran: no provider call, no tool call, no container, no attempt evidence and no usage in either attempt of either cell. The failure is the GitHub-hosted runner's Docker client being refused by public.ecr.aws while building the task image, which is the host environment the task container is created in — the class AGENTS.md admits.
preModelEnvironmentFailure.whyOneMoreAttemptIsNotRepetition: The mechanism is a shared public-registry quota, not a property of the cell that a repeat measurement would confirm: it is keyed to the anonymous-pull quota of whichever runner IP issues the request, and each Generate job runs on a different GitHub-hosted runner. Three of the five cells in the preceding serial batch pulled images from the same ECR repository successfully in the same hours, including the third-largest image (meriyah, 876.2 MiB), so neither the repository nor the image size is a deterministic blocker; the two repeatedly-failed cells are simply the two largest images (975.1 and 857.4 MiB of 749.5-975.1 MiB across the five), and a larger pull is the likelier candidate for a data-quota refusal. A third draw therefore still measures the environment rather than the cell, which is the same reasoning the 2026-10-01 ECR recovery used when its own third attempt also succeeded ('a shared-quota throttle on a public registry ... a third measurement of a quota event therefore still measures the environment').
